notes: New DJ PRO tab: the whole mixer, both decks and the effect knobs on one screen with no scrolling, for when you want density over comfort.
SYNC now refuses to lock onto a beat grid it is not confident about, instead of quietly drifting a few bars later.
Import your library from Rekordbox, Traktor, VirtualDJ, Serato, Mixxx or Engine DJ - tracks, cue points, beat grids, keys and playlists come across.
Per-stem gain knobs on the DJ PRO decks, so you can pull the vocal or the drums down without touching the EQ.
This build also carries the beat-grid, waveform-scroll and CMD STUDIO 2A jog fixes announced with 0.6.0.
